Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly switched the director from J. Robert Oppenheimer to Norris Bradbury by conflating the post-war Los Alamos lab directorship (Bradbury) with the wartime leadership during the development of the first atomic bomb. This misinterpretation of the historical timeline and roles, without proper verification, led to the wrong conclusion despite evidence pointing to Oppenheimer and the Los Alamos “Water Boiler” context.
